# GitHub fixtures

Captured 2026-09-13 with `gh api markdown -f mode=gfm -F text=@INPUT`.

## autolinks/brackets

```````````````````````````````` example
[www.a.com] [a](www.b.com) [http://a.com](/u) ![www.a.com](/i)
.
<p>[www.a.com] <a href="www.b.com">a</a> <a href="/u">http://a.com</a> <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/i"><img src="/i" alt="www.a.com" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
````````````````````````````````

## autolinks/code

```````````````````````````````` example
`www.a.com` `a@b.cd`
.
<p><code class="notranslate">www.a.com</code> <code class="notranslate">a@b.cd</code></p>
````````````````````````````````

## autolinks/context

```````````````````````````````` example
*www.a.com* _http://a.com_ ~www.a.com~ xwww.a.com a:www.a.com
.
<p><em><a href="http://www.a.com" rel="nofollow">www.a.com</a></em> <em>http://a.com</em> <del><a href="http://www.a.com" rel="nofollow">www.a.com</a></del> xwww.a.com a:www.a.com</p>
````````````````````````````````

## autolinks/email

```````````````````````````````` example
a@b.com a.b+c@d.e.f a@b.c. a@b.c- mailto:a@b.cc xmpp:a@b.cc/d
.
<p><a href="mailto:a@b.com">a@b.com</a> <a href="mailto:a.b+c@d.e.f">a.b+c@d.e.f</a> <a href="mailto:a@b.c">a@b.c</a>. a@b.c- <a href="mailto:a@b.cc">mailto:a@b.cc</a> <a href="xmpp:a@b.cc/d">xmpp:a@b.cc/d</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

## autolinks/escapes-and-entities

```````````````````````````````` example
a\_b@c.de &#97;@b.cd http://a.b/\_c
.
<p><a href="mailto:a_b@c.de">a_b@c.de</a> <a href="mailto:a@b.cd">a@b.cd</a> <a href="http://a.b/%5C_c" rel="nofollow">http://a.b/\_c</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

## autolinks/less-than

```````````````````````````````` example
www.a.com/b<c http://a.com<d
.
<p><a href="http://www.a.com/b" rel="nofollow">www.a.com/b</a>&lt;c <a href="http://a.com" rel="nofollow">http://a.com</a>&lt;d</p>
````````````````````````````````

## autolinks/underscores

```````````````````````````````` example
www.a_b.c.d www.a.b_c.d www.a.b.c_d
.
<p><a href="http://www.a_b.c.d" rel="nofollow">www.a_b.c.d</a> www.a.b_c.d www.a.b.c_d</p>
````````````````````````````````

## autolinks/url

```````````````````````````````` example
http://a.com https://a.com/b HTTP://A.COM x http://a.com, http://a
.
<p><a href="http://a.com" rel="nofollow">http://a.com</a> <a href="https://a.com/b" rel="nofollow">https://a.com/b</a> <a href="HTTP://A.COM" rel="nofollow">HTTP://A.COM</a> x <a href="http://a.com" rel="nofollow">http://a.com</a>, <a href="http://a" rel="nofollow">http://a</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

## autolinks/www

```````````````````````````````` example
www.a.com www.a.com/b?c=d&e=f www.a.com. (www.a.com) www.a.com/(b)) www.a.com/b&c;
.
<p><a href="http://www.a.com" rel="nofollow">www.a.com</a> <a href="http://www.a.com/b?c=d&amp;e=f" rel="nofollow">www.a.com/b?c=d&amp;e=f</a> <a href="http://www.a.com" rel="nofollow">www.a.com</a>. (<a href="http://www.a.com" rel="nofollow">www.a.com</a>) <a href="http://www.a.com/(b)" rel="nofollow">www.a.com/(b)</a>) <a href="http://www.a.com/b" rel="nofollow">www.a.com/b</a>&amp;c;</p>
````````````````````````````````

## dialect/definition-underline

```````````````````````````````` example
[foo]: /url
---
.
<p>---</p>
````````````````````````````````

## dialect/flanking-symbol

```````````````````````````````` example
£_a_£
.
<p>£_a_£</p>
````````````````````````````````

## dialect/html-block-declaration

```````````````````````````````` example
<!doctype html>
.
<p>&lt;!doctype html&gt;</p>
````````````````````````````````

## dialect/html-block-lazy-line

```````````````````````````````` example
> a
<del>
*b*
.
<blockquote>
<p>a</p>
</blockquote>
<del>
*b*</del>
````````````````````````````````

## dialect/html-block-search

```````````````````````````````` example
a
<search>
*b*
.
<p>a<br>
<br>
<em>b</em></p>
````````````````````````````````

## dialect/html-block-source

```````````````````````````````` example
a
<source>
*b*
.
<p>a</p>
<source>
*b*
````````````````````````````````

## dialect/html-comment

```````````````````````````````` example
a <!--> b --> <!-- c -- d --->
.
<p>a  b --&gt; &lt;!-- c -- d ---&gt;</p>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/basic

```````````````````````````````` example
Text[^1] and more[^note].

[^1]: One.
[^note]: Two.
.
<p>Text<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-50e900edd5d3e55508dbbb4a5e8fae71" id="user-content-fnref-1-50e900edd5d3e55508dbbb4a5e8fae71" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup> and more<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-note-50e900edd5d3e55508dbbb4a5e8fae71" id="user-content-fnref-note-50e900edd5d3e55508dbbb4a5e8fae71" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">2</a></sup>.</p>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-50e900edd5d3e55508dbbb4a5e8fae71">
<p>One. <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-50e900edd5d3e55508dbbb4a5e8fae71" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
<li id="user-content-fn-note-50e900edd5d3e55508dbbb4a5e8fae71">
<p>Two. <a href="#user-content-fnref-note-50e900edd5d3e55508dbbb4a5e8fae71" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 2" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/blank-first-line

```````````````````````````````` example
a[^1]

[^1]:

    para
.
<p>a<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-91f57b21cb6b825e381478fd9e612227" id="user-content-fnref-1-91f57b21cb6b825e381478fd9e612227" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup></p>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-91f57b21cb6b825e381478fd9e612227">
<p>para <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-91f57b21cb6b825e381478fd9e612227" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/blocks

```````````````````````````````` example
a[^1]

[^1]:
    > quote

        code

    para
.
<p>a<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-a34eecc947dde06d8785930913e71921" id="user-content-fnref-1-a34eecc947dde06d8785930913e71921" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup></p>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-a34eecc947dde06d8785930913e71921">
<blockquote>
<p>quote</p>
</blockquote>
<pre class="notranslate"><code class="notranslate">code
</code></pre>
<p>para <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-a34eecc947dde06d8785930913e71921" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/docs-footnotes

```````````````````````````````` example
Here is a simple footnote[^1].

A footnote can also have multiple lines[^2].

[^1]: My reference.
[^2]: To add line breaks within a footnote, add 2 spaces to the end of a line.  
This is a second line.
.
<p>Here is a simple footnote<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-09cefb548459105baf6d8fe10e762b21" id="user-content-fnref-1-09cefb548459105baf6d8fe10e762b21" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup>.</p>
<p>A footnote can also have multiple lines<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-2-09cefb548459105baf6d8fe10e762b21" id="user-content-fnref-2-09cefb548459105baf6d8fe10e762b21" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">2</a></sup>.</p>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-09cefb548459105baf6d8fe10e762b21">
<p>My reference. <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-09cefb548459105baf6d8fe10e762b21" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
<li id="user-content-fn-2-09cefb548459105baf6d8fe10e762b21">
<p>To add line breaks within a footnote, add 2 spaces to the end of a line.<br>
This is a second line. <a href="#user-content-fnref-2-09cefb548459105baf6d8fe10e762b21" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 2" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/emphasis

```````````````````````````````` example
a[^*b*] *c[^d]*

[^*b*]: x
[^d]: y
.
<p>a<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-*b*-5ce85e4f1ae7396a93f537b9c19614e2" id="user-content-fnref-*b*-5ce85e4f1ae7396a93f537b9c19614e2" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup> <em>c<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-d-5ce85e4f1ae7396a93f537b9c19614e2" id="user-content-fnref-d-5ce85e4f1ae7396a93f537b9c19614e2" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">2</a></sup></em></p>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-*b*-5ce85e4f1ae7396a93f537b9c19614e2">
<p>x <a href="#user-content-fnref-*b*-5ce85e4f1ae7396a93f537b9c19614e2" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
<li id="user-content-fn-d-5ce85e4f1ae7396a93f537b9c19614e2">
<p>y <a href="#user-content-fnref-d-5ce85e4f1ae7396a93f537b9c19614e2" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 2" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/escaped-caret

```````````````````````````````` example
a[\^1] b[&#94;1]

[^1]: x
.
<p>a[^1]] b[^</p>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/in-containers

```````````````````````````````` example
> a[^1]
>
> [^1]: quoted

- b[^2]

  [^2]: listed
.
<blockquote>
<p>a<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-57004c8e6ddd69bca050459136e88fa0" id="user-content-fnref-1-57004c8e6ddd69bca050459136e88fa0" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>
<p>b<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-2-57004c8e6ddd69bca050459136e88fa0" id="user-content-fnref-2-57004c8e6ddd69bca050459136e88fa0" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">2</a></sup></p>
</li>
</ul>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-57004c8e6ddd69bca050459136e88fa0">
<p>quoted <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-57004c8e6ddd69bca050459136e88fa0" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
<li id="user-content-fn-2-57004c8e6ddd69bca050459136e88fa0">
<p>listed <a href="#user-content-fnref-2-57004c8e6ddd69bca050459136e88fa0" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 2" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/in-image

```````````````````````````````` example
![b [^1]](/i)

[^1]: x
.
<p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/i"><img src="/i" alt="b " style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-b899cf2685615d63ce6d1a3883cfd889">
<p>x <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-b899cf2685615d63ce6d1a3883cfd889" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/in-table

```````````````````````````````` example
| a[^1] |
| - |
| b[^1] |

[^1]: x
.
<markdown-accessiblity-table><table role="table">
<thead>
<tr>
<th>a<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-2cab4297cf4d4a1c1d976d1f44001d7e" id="user-content-fnref-1-2cab4297cf4d4a1c1d976d1f44001d7e" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>b<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-2cab4297cf4d4a1c1d976d1f44001d7e" id="user-content-fnref-1-2-2cab4297cf4d4a1c1d976d1f44001d7e" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-2cab4297cf4d4a1c1d976d1f44001d7e">
<p>x <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-2cab4297cf4d4a1c1d976d1f44001d7e" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a> <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-2-2cab4297cf4d4a1c1d976d1f44001d7e" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1-2" class="data-footnote-backref">↩<sup>2</sup></a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/label-case

```````````````````````````````` example
a[^Note]

[^note]: N.
.
<p>a<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-note-afb954eca3670fc5b7a2241ac568d5f2" id="user-content-fnref-note-afb954eca3670fc5b7a2241ac568d5f2" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup></p>

<p>N. <a href="#user-content-fnref-note-afb954eca3670fc5b7a2241ac568d5f2" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>

</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/label-line-ending

```````````````````````````````` example
a[^b
c]

[^b]: x
.
<p>a[^]</p>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/label-space

```````````````````````````````` example
a[^a b]

[^a b]: /u
.
<p>a<a href="/u">^a b</a></p>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/lazy

```````````````````````````````` example
a[^1]

[^1]: one
two
.
<p>a<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-bde3128f2e1b43806125bede3b1ad653" id="user-content-fnref-1-bde3128f2e1b43806125bede3b1ad653" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup></p>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-bde3128f2e1b43806125bede3b1ad653">
<p>one<br>
two <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-bde3128f2e1b43806125bede3b1ad653" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## footnotes/nested-definition

```````````````````````````````` example
a[^1] b[^2]

[^1]: one
    [^2]: two
.
<p>a<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-1-1acacfbc461b2cef2e327db3bc1b1ee2" id="user-content-fnref-1-1acacfbc461b2cef2e327db3bc1b1ee2" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">1</a></sup> b<sup><a href="#user-content-fn-2-1acacfbc461b2cef2e327db3bc1b1ee2" id="user-content-fnref-2-1acacfbc461b2cef2e327db3bc1b1ee2" data-footnote-ref="" aria-describedby="footnote-label">2</a></sup></p>
<section data-footnotes="" class="footnotes"><h2 id="footnote-label" class="sr-only">Footnotes</h2>
<ol>
<li id="user-content-fn-1-1acacfbc461b2cef2e327db3bc1b1ee2">
<p>one <a href="#user-content-fnref-1-1acacfbc461b2cef2e327db3bc1b1ee2" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 1" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
<li id="user-content-fn-2-1acacfbc461b2cef2e327db3bc1b1ee2">
<p>two <a href="#user-content-fnref-2-1acacfbc461b2cef2e327db3bc1b1ee2" data-footnote-backref="" aria-label="Back to reference 2" class="data-footnote-backref">↩</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough/basic

```````````````````````````````` example
~a~ ~~b~~ ~~~c~~~
.
<p><del>a</del> <del>b</del> ~~~c~~~</p>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough/escapes

```````````````````````````````` example
\~a~ ~b\~
.
<p>~a~ ~b~</p>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough/flanking

```````````````````````````````` example
a~b~c ~ d ~ e~ f ~g
.
<p>a<del>b</del>c ~ d ~ e~ f ~g</p>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough/lines

```````````````````````````````` example
~~a
b~~
.
<p><del>a<br>
b</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough/links

```````````````````````````````` example
~~[a](/u)~~ [~b~](/v)
.
<p><del><a href="/u">a</a></del> <a href="/v"><del>b</del></a></p>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough/mismatch

```````````````````````````````` example
~a~~ ~~b~
.
<p>~a~~ ~~b~</p>
````````````````````````````````

## strikethrough/nesting

```````````````````````````````` example
~~*a*~~ *~~b~~* ~~a ~b~ c~~
.
<p><del><em>a</em></del> <em><del>b</del></em> <del>a <del>b</del> c</del></p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
| - |

</thead>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
````````````````````````````````
